stories.title: The Flintshire sniffer dogs helping the National Crime Agency search high street shops
stories.summary: Detection dogs from Flintshire company Wagtail UK have helped find hidden illegal tobacco during a UK-wide operation against money laundering on high streets. stories.title: State Pension is biggest part of welfare bill in both Flintshire constituencies, think tank figures show
stories.summary: The State Pension is the biggest part of a welfare bill that outstrips income tax and National Insurance in both constituencies covering Flintshire, according to figures from the Adam Smith Institute. stories.title: £100 cost of living payment for households in bands A to D
stories.summary: Every household in council tax bands A to D in Wales is to get a £100 cost of living payment, the Welsh Government has announced. The payment will also go to everyone who gets council tax reduction, whatever band their home is in. Sioned Williams, the Deputy First Minister and Cabinet Minister for Social Justice

stories.title: Reform MS tells Senedd there should be “no more devolution in any area”
stories.summary: There should be “no more devolution in any area”, a Reform MS has told the Senedd. Sir Gaerfyrddin MS, Sarah Edwards, said Reform’s position on further devolution is “clear” and called for the Welsh Government to “do better with the powers [they] already have”. stories.title: Final objection window opens on Flintshire Catholic super-school plans
stories.summary: Objections to the £55 million Flint 3-18 school must be received by 5pm on December 8, with four existing Catholic schools set to close.
